questions.question: Welche Hauptstadt liegt am Victoriasee und ist die größte Stadt Ugandas?
questions.explanation: Kampala ist die Hauptstadt Ugandas und liegt nahe dem Victoriasee. Die Stadt ist ein wichtiges wirtschaftliches und kulturelles Zentrum in der Region Ostafrika.

questions.question: Which river flows directly into the Mediterranean Sea?
questions.explanation: The Rhone is a significant river in France that flows directly into the Mediterranean Sea. In contrast, the Danube flows into the Black Sea, while the Elbe flows into the North Sea and the Seine into the English Channel.

questions.question: Which volcanic island arc is mainly formed by the subduction of the North American Plate under the Pacific Plate?
questions.explanation: The Aleutian Island Arc extends along the coast of Alaska and is the result of the subduction of the North American Plate under the Pacific Plate. This geological activity leads to a variety of volcanoes in the region.

questions.question: Which city is located on the banks of the Rhine River and is known for its old town and university?
questions.explanation: Bonn is located in western Germany on the Rhine River and was the capital of the Federal Republic of Germany until 1990. The city has a historic old town and a renowned university.
